name: io.github.schnueck/bring-photo-mcp
description: Verified Bring shopping-list operations with catalog classification and optional product photos.

environmentVariables.name: BRING_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Runtime boundary: use test for dedicated test lists or prod for explicitly allowlisted production lists.

environmentVariables.name: BRING_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email address of the Bring account.

environmentVariables.name: BRING_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of the Bring account. Store it only in the client or secret-manager environment.

environmentVariables.name: BRING_DEFAULT_LIST
environmentVariables.description: Exact name of the default Bring list.

environmentVariables.name: BRING_ALLOWED_LISTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated exact names of every Bring list the server may access.

environmentVariables.name: BRING_TEST_ITEM_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: Required non-empty item-name prefix for opt-in live E2E runs in test mode.

environmentVariables.name: BRING_TEST_SECOND_LIST
environmentVariables.description: Optional exact name of a second dedicated test list for copy, move, and multi-list E2E checks.
